questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

9, 43

13, 63
questions.solution:
The logic followed in the given number-pairs is:

**Logic: Second number = First number × 5 - 2.**

**9, 43**

→ 9 × 5 - 2

→ 45 - 2

→ 43 = Second number. This holds.

**13, 63**

→ 13 × 5 - 2

→ 65 - 2

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) of the following equation, if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

15 + 9 ÷ 2 – 63 × 3 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged.
 
• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

15 + 9 ÷ 2 − 63 × 3 = ?

After applying the interchange rules, the equation becomes:

15 − 9 × 2 + 63 ÷ 3 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS rule:

= 15 − **9 × 2**__ + __**63 ÷ 3**__

= __**15 − 18**__ + 21

= __**-3 + 21**__

= 18

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All the pianos are instruments.

All the instruments are flutes.

Conclusions:

(I) All the flutes are instruments.

(II) All the pianos are flutes.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All the pianos are instruments.

All the instruments are flutes.

The Venn Diagram for the given statements is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f125d0a981a79efc8e68dd08b3a4c4b7921a98937ed0b14b95240dabf5ad9f2.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All the flutes are instruments - **False** (The statement is 'All Instruments are Flutes', which does not mean 'All Flutes are Instruments'. There can be flutes that are not instruments).

II. All the pianos are flutes - **True** (Since all Pianos are Instruments, and all Instruments are Flutes, it must be that all Pianos are Flutes).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
